title: Formula with an escaped quote passes validation but fails at run time
symptoms: Scenario deactivates itself on the first real run
Module and blueprint validators reported no problems
cause: Make formula string literals have no escape characters. A backslash before a quote does not produce a quote; the quote ends the string and the formula cannot be parsed. Static validation does not catch it, only a live run does.
fix: Keep quote characters out of formula strings. To match text that contains quotes, use a regex with \W or . where the quote would be.
apply: Regex pattern intent\W+([a-z]+) instead of a pattern that contains an escaped quote.
